end.summary:
Practised the five levels of organisation: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
Gave human examples including muscle cell → muscle tissue → stomach → digestive system → human.
Discussed plant and human examples at each level.
Clarified that the heart is one organ, while the circulatory system includes the heart, blood, and blood vessels.
Ordering was practised three times; teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Yash practised ordering the levels and matching examples for humans and plants. They used the muscle cell → muscle tissue → stomach → digestive system → human sequence and explained why the heart is part of, but not the whole of, the circulatory system. There was a mix-up between an organ and an organ system; this was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Yash to arrange the five terms and give one human and one plant example for each.
